story_overview: A girl named Seren can enter and walk through other people's memories. She uses this ability to help a grieving old king find a lost memory — a promise he made to his daughter before she disappeared. As Seren walks through his memories, she discovers the daughter is not gone but trapped inside her own memory — a trauma so powerful it became a world. To free her, Seren must walk into the memory-world and help the girl remember who she was before the pain.

speech: The garden was beautiful. Too beautiful. Seren had walked enough memories to know that perfect things are usually hiding something.
She found the door behind a hedge. It should not have been there. Memories do not have doors. Unless someone put one there. Unless someone needed to hide something.

She opened it. The garden screamed. Not out loud. But Seren felt it. A memory does not like being disturbed. But some memories need to be disturbed.
She stepped through. The darkness swallowed her. And then she was somewhere else. Somewhere sad. Somewhere a little girl had been hiding for a very long time.
